videos.title: How El Nino and two wars are driving the next food price crisis | DW News

moments.quote: Now that war in Ukraine is still ongoing, and this year the Iran war has piled on top of it.
moments.why: La journaliste Hannah Hummel mentionne la poursuite de la guerre en Ukraine et le conflit impliquant l'Iran comme facteurs pesant sur la situation alimentaire mondiale au début du reportage basé sur les données et avertissements de la FAO.

videos.title: FAO issues warning: Is the world on the brink of an unprecedented food shock?
videos.authority_why: chaîne non répertoriée (235 000 abonnés) — ajoutée faute de source forte sur ce sujet

moments.quote: A serious warning issued by the FAO... The UN Food and Agriculture Organization, FAO, warns of a global food crisis that could erupt within just six months to one year.
moments.why: The video explicitly reports on the FAO warning about a upcoming global food crisis caused by conflicts and regional tensions (such as Iran and Strait of Hormuz).

moments.quote: The FAO stressed that what is happening marks 'the beginning of a systemic agrifood shock'... The international organization warned that the decisions being made today will determine the scale of the coming catastrophe.
moments.why: The video highlights the FAO's report warning of systemic agrifood shock and impending global catastrophe due to conflict-related trade disruptions.

articles.title: Global food prices at three-year high as heatwaves and wars push up crop costs

passages.quote: Global food prices have hit their highest level in three and a half years, as summer heatwaves and conflict in Ukraine and the Middle East push up crop costs. The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) index of food commodity prices rose last month to its highest level since January 2023, after a jump in prices for cereals, sugar and vegetable oil.
passages.why: L'article rapporte l'indice des prix de la FAO et attribue la flambée des cours alimentaires aux canicules et aux conflits en Ukraine et au Moyen-Orient (avec mention ultérieure de la guerre en Iran).
